prompts.enhanced: From a static surveillance camera, a rigid robot arm smoothly approaches the orange cheese wedge on the counter, ensuring stable joint geometry without teleporting. The gripper makes firm physical contact, securely grasping the cheese before lifting. The cheese rigidly follows the gripper trajectory without passing through other objects. The arm moves continuously over the cutting board and lowers, opening its gripper to release the cheese exactly on top of the bread slice to complete the dish.
prompts.standard: Pick up the wedge of cheese and place it on the slice of bread to prepare a simple cheese on bread dish.
